text: PlanSmart automates the generation of recovery and reconstruction plans using hazard and risk data from GeoRiskPH, a unified national database. It offers preformulated, customizable plan templates and sector-specific modules. The platform is embedded in a broader risk financing architecture, including Cat-DDO, to ensure rapid access to funds. Over 2,300 officials have been trained in risk-informed recovery planning, with 500+ trained specifically on using PlanSmart.
